note: The densities of the material roles of World (kg/m3), each with its source. A role with no density (a paint, a color) has no mass.

density.source: Each density has its own source.

steel: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): steel 7.82.
chrome: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): steel 7.82 (chrome on steel).
metal: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): steel 7.82.
rim: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): aluminum 2.7 (a cast or a rolled rim of aluminum).
aluminum: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): aluminum 2.7.
copper: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): copper 8.79.
glass: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): glass, common 2.4-2.8 (the middle).
glass_dark: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): glass, common 2.4-2.8 (the middle).
glass_amber: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): glass, common 2.4-2.8 (the middle).
porcelain: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): porcelain 2.3-2.5 (the middle).
terracotta: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): brick 1.4-2.4 (the middle: terracotta is fired clay, as a brick).
brick: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): brick 1.4-2.4 (the middle).
tile: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): brick 1.4-2.4 (the middle: a clay roof tile is fired clay).
concrete: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): concrete, dense 2.0-2.4 (normal concrete).
mortar: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): brickwork in mortar 1.6.
rubber: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): rubber, pure gum 0.91-0.93 (the middle).
plastic: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): ABS 1.06.
plywood: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): plywood 0.54.
wood: The Engineering ToolBox, Wood densities (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/wood-density-d_40.html): spruce, Canadian 450 (the spruce of spruce-pine-fir lumber).
eps: ASTM C578, Type I expanded polystyrene: 0.90 lb/ft3 (14.4 kg/m3) at the least. The core of an insulated door.
eps_helmet: Trzaskalska and Chwastek, Archives of Metallurgy and Materials 66 (2021): the liners of motorcycle helmets are EPS of 40 to 50 kg/m3 (the middle).
nylon: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): Nylon 6,6 1.13-1.15 (the middle).
pom: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): POM - poly oxy methylene 1.4.
pu_foam: The Engineering ToolBox, Densities of solids (https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html): PU - poly urethane foam 0.03.
sao: PROSEA (Plant Resources of South-East Asia), Hopea odorata (sao đen): 620-930 kg/m3 at 15% moisture (the middle). A wood of boats (https://prosea.prota4u.org/view.aspx?id=3545).
